scope_boundary: Opportunity, workflow, synthetic, sample, and buyer-authorized non-PHI organization data only. No credentials, final certifications, signatures, or autonomous submissions.

minimum_sample.alternate_sample_rule: A lower sample is valid only when the buyer documents the expected source volume before the pilot and both parties approve the alternate denominator.

permitted_sources: buyer-approved official public opportunity pages and feeds
buyer-provided eligibility and workflow rules approved for pilot use
synthetic or de-identified sample organization records
buyer-approved internal timestamps and defect labels
prohibited_inputs: unreleased proposal content unless a written private-data agreement permits it
deliverables: review-only candidate queue with abstention reasons
final metric workbook and claim-bounded decision memo
exclusions: guaranteed eligibility, award, savings, or revenue
final certification, signature, upload, send, or submission
production use of protected or controlled data

acceptance_metrics.denominator: all candidate matches reviewed by the buyer

acceptance_metrics.numerator: sum of elapsed hours from discovery to documented decision
acceptance_metrics.denominator: opportunities receiving a documented pursue or no-pursue decision

acceptance_metrics.numerator: sum of elapsed hours from pursue decision to buyer-defined internal review state
missing, contradictory, stale, or ownerless required items found at review
acceptance_metrics.denominator: required package items inspected at review

acceptance_metrics.numerator: pursued packages reaching internal review by the frozen buyer cutoff
acceptance_metrics.denominator: pursued packages with an open verified deadline

acceptance_metrics.numerator: material claims carrying a traceable reviewed source

acceptance_thresholds.rule: No metric is called improved or accepted until the buyer approves its baseline, threshold, denominator, exclusions, and cutoff before pilot measurement.

raci.buyer_workflow_owner: accountable for source permissions, eligibility rules, thresholds, and acceptance
raci.buyer_authorized_official: accountable for every certification, signature, send, upload, and final submission
raci.lumencore_operator: responsible for configured monitoring, draft assembly, blocker ledgers, and receipts
raci.lumencore_founder: accountable for scope, pricing, public claims, and any external communication
raci.legal_or_security_reviewer: consulted when data, confidentiality, IP, export, or regulated-domain terms require review

retention_and_security.deletion_rule: Delete or return buyer data after the approved retention period unless a signed agreement specifies another period.
retention_and_security.access_rule: Least-privilege named users only; no credentials or protected data in public artifacts.
retention_and_security.incident_rule: Stop processing, preserve bounded logs, notify the named buyer owner, and follow the signed incident procedure.

support_boundary.included: One kickoff, one weekly review, asynchronous blocker triage during agreed business hours, and one final readout.
support_boundary.excluded: 24-hour operations, legal representation, portal administration, managed submission, or production SLA unless separately contracted.

pricing.rule: No price is offered until buyer scope, source count, seat count, support level, data terms, and acceptance plan are approved.

human_gates: buyer confirms organizational eligibility and source permissions
buyer approves claims, representations, thresholds, and package content
authorized official certifies, signs, uploads, sends, and submits
LumenCore cannot bypass portal attestations, account controls, or signatures
founder approves exact scope, price, recipient, and external communication
